title: Swarm Shepherd: Securing Multi-Agent Ecosystems Against Persistent Latent Compromise
abstract: arXiv:2611.18693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic ecosystems are emerging as a new platform layer in which agents maintain persistent memory, retrieve from shared knowledge bases, execute through tool interfaces, and coordinate through shared states. These capabilities create a security problem that per-turn defenses miss: compromise can accumulate across sessions, agents, and system layers before visible failure. We define this threat as Agentic Sleeper, a system-level adversary that first behaves legitimately, gains routing trust, and later activates across memory, agent logic, and infrastructure. We formulate defense as inference under partial observability and propose Swarm Shepherd, a system-level defense framework centered on an inference filter for early warning, paired with a backward trace-back module for entry attribution. Our analysis yields a two-scale deployment rule that balances longer event histories against broader agent coverage. Across LangGraph, CrewAI, and

translated_title: Swarm Shepherd：保障多智能体生态系统免受持续性潜伏威胁
translated_abstract: 智能体生态系统正在成为一种新的平台层，其中智能体可以维护持久记忆、从共享知识库中检索信息、通过工具接口执行操作，并通过共享状态进行协调。这些能力带来了一个逐轮防御机制所无法察觉的安全问题：威胁可能在会话、智能体和系统层级之间逐步累积，直到出现明显的故障才被发现。我们将这种威胁定义为“智能体休眠者”，这是一种系统级对手，起初表现得完全合法，获取路由信任，随后在记忆、智能体逻辑和基础设施中同时激活。我们将防御问题形式化为部分可观测性下的推理问题，并提出了 Swarm Shepherd，这是一个系统级防御框架，其核心是一个用于早期预警的推理过滤器，并配有一个用于入口归因的向后追溯模块。我们的分析得出了一个双尺度部署规则，以在更长的事件历史与更广的智能体覆盖范围之间取得平衡。在 LangGraph、CrewAI 以及……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出系统级防御框架 Swarm Shepherd，通过推理过滤器实现早期预警、配合向后追溯模块进行入口归因，以应对在多智能体生态系统中跨会话、跨层级潜伏累积的“智能体休眠者”攻击。
en_tdlr: Proposes Swarm Shepherd, a system-level defense framework that combines an inference filter for early warning with a backward trace-back module for entry attribution, to defend multi-agent ecosystems against stealthy "Agentic Sleeper" compromises that accumulate across sessions, agents, and system layers.
